'''Gondrin Upal'''<ref name="DaG" /> was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Brothers" /> [[Freighter tramper/Legends|freighter tramper]]<ref name="DaG" /> and [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]].<ref name="Brothers" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Upal traveled with two other members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] aboard<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the ''[[Jendirian Valley/Legends|Jendirian Valley]]'', an [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 Coruscant freighter]] transporting refugees<ref name="DB1">{{DB|starship|starfreighter|starfreighter}}</ref> from<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="AOTC" /> During transit, the Upal and the other [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] stood at a table while the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] grabbed [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who were both disguised as refugees. Upal, soon after, sat alone at a different table and drank from a bowl.<ref name="DaG" />

While aboard the ''Jendirian Valley'', Upal wore an [[Color/Legends|indigo]] freighter traveler quilted [[Jerkin/Legends|jerkin]], indigo [[Clothing/Legends|pants]], and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. The Nikto had blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], orange skin, and three-digit [[Limb/Legends|hands]].<ref name="DaG" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Gondrin Upal first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> The ''Jendirian Valley'' scenes with Upal, who was portrayed by an uncredited actor, were filmed at building 48 of [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> A scene where Skywalker is woken up from a bad dream by Amidala, in which Upal is visible in the background, was cut from the film.<ref name="Nightmare">{{Film|II}} &mdash; Deleted Scene: Anakin's Nightmare</ref> On [[July 31]], [[2001]],<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> the character was first revealed, before the film's release, in the web documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]]."<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> Upal, unnamed in Episode II, was first identified in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]].<ref name="DaG" />
